text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to interview for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board. Following the interviews, the Civic Appointments Committee will recommend eight candidates for appointment to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates to be interviewed at its next meeting for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board: TPL2-470 TPL2-760 TPL2-694 TPL2-734 TPL2-706 TPL2-651 TPL2-633 TPL2-726 TPL2-524 TPL2-630 TPL2-678 TPL2-600 TPL2-576 TPL2-714 TPL2-579 TPL2-673 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (December 23, 2022) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety, as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board.
